Bookmarked: Ruha Benjamin | Digital Pedagogy Lab 2019 | A New Jim Code? - YouTube #digped

https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=1001&v=wJPhN4mucCQ

The Three Main Points

Racism is productive.

Not in being good, but in the literal capacity to produce even why it does harm to others

Think about race and technology shape one another

social norms, values, structures exist before tech. It is not the impact of technology but social inputs

Imagination is a contested field of action not an ephemeral afterthought

A resource, a battleground, an input and an output of technology and social order. In fact, we should acknowledge that most people are forced to live inside someone else's imagination. One thing we have to come to grips with is the nightmare many people are forced to endure are the underside of elite fantasies about efficiency, profit, and control. Racism among other actions of domination helps produce this fragmentation of imagination misery for some and monopoly for others.
